summary: Surfaced by MPI-464's Pod verification, and it is not that card's bug so it was split out rather than folded in. The remote uninstall loop treats every non-unsupported wrapper answer as a successful delete, but remoteUninstallDep already distinguishes 'not_found'. Live numbers: uninstalling nvidia-pid reported 8 removed against 1 real delete, because the model read 3/11 installed and seven of those files simply were not there. The reason it matters beyond a wrong log line is that removed[] rides the download:uninstalled broadcast into MpiModelManager. Classic engine-split half-fix - MPI-276 wrote the local half (pathExists gate, missing path to keptModelFiles reason 'already-absent') and the remote half was never written, so the fix should mirror that bucket and reason string rather than invent a second rule. One thing to decide deliberately: once not_found stops inflating removed[], the anyUnsupported && removed.length === 0 early-return can newly fire on an old Pod image.

Picked up. Confirmed the bug at the source before touching code: wrapper.py models_delete returns status not_found when the path was absent, remoteUninstallDep passes it through verbatim, and the remote loop else-branch swallows it into removed[]. Traced the blast radius the brief asked for - removed[] is consumed in exactly one renderer place, the download:uninstalled handler in MpiModelManager, where it drives toast copy only (no counts, no freed-space text). That read changes the fix shape: a pure mirror of the local bucket would MOVE the lie rather than kill it, because already-absent deps land in keptModelFiles and the handler counts that as kept - a model whose files were all already gone would toast files kept on disk, still installed. The local twin has that same toast bug today. So the fix is two parts: mirror the bucket and reason string in the remote loop, and teach the handler that already-absent means gone, not kept, which fixes both engines in one place.

Shipped and closed. The remote loop now buckets the wrapper answer not_found into keptModelFiles with reason already-absent, the local twin's exact bucket and string, so removed[] means a delete ran on both engines. The second half came out of the blast-radius read the brief asked for: removed[] drives toast copy in MpiModelManager and nothing else, and a pure mirror would have moved the lie rather than killed it, because absent deps counted as kept made the handler say model files kept on disk, still installed for a model with nothing left. That was a LOCAL bug too, live since MPI-276, so the handler now treats already-absent as gone and one fix covers both engines. Evidence: a new route-level test over a stubbed wrapper covering the measured 1-of-8 shape, an empty volume and an old image, green and proven to fail when the new branch is disabled; and the three toast branches driven for real in a browser against the mounted component. The early-return the brief flagged does fire more often now and that is the right answer - an old image deleted nothing, so the install record survives. No live Pod: this card removes a false claim, it deletes nothing new, and wrapper.py was read rather than assumed. Suite is 475 pass 3 fail, the three being a peer session's in-flight LTX files, still failing with both edits stashed.
